_about: Public-domain Pope Leo XIII (1810-1903) in English for the Word Hoard: The Great Encyclical Letters (Benziger, 1903), The Pope and the People, ed. W. H. Eyre (1895), his Lenten pastorals as Cardinal Pecci, The Church and Civilization (1878), the principal encyclicals in their official English translations (Immortale Dei, Rerum Novarum, Providentissimus Deus, Satis Cognitum, the letters on reunion and on slavery), and his Latin poems in two English versions (1887, 1902), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

leo-great-encyclicals: The Great Encyclical Letters of Pope Leo XIII, preface by John J. Wynne (New York, Cincinnati, Chicago: Benziger Brothers; title page undated, copyright 1903)
leo-pope-and-people: The Pope and the People: Select Letters and Addresses on Social Questions, ed. W. H. Eyre (London and Leamington: Art and Book Company, 1895)
leo-church-civilization: The Church and Civilization: Pastoral Letters for Lent 1877-1878, by Cardinal Pecci (New York: P. O'Shea, 1878)
leo-immortale-dei: Encyclical Letter on the Christian Constitution of States (Immortale Dei), Latin text and authorised translation (London, 1886)
leo-condition-of-labor: On the Condition of Labor (Rerum Novarum), official translation (New York, Cincinnati, Chicago: Benziger Brothers, 1891)
leo-study-holy-scripture: Encyclical Letter on the Study of Holy Scripture (Providentissimus Deus), official translation (Staten Island: Mission of the Immaculate Virgin, 1894)
leo-reunion-christendom: Apostolic Letter on the Reunion of Christendom (Praeclara gratulationis), reprinted from The Universe (London, 1894)
leo-unity-of-church: Encyclical Letter on the Unity of the Church (Satis Cognitum), authorised translation (London: Catholic Truth Society; title page undated, the encyclical dated 29 June 1896)
leo-church-and-slavery: Leo XIII to the Bishops of Brazil on the Church and Slavery (Baltimore: John Murphy for St. Joseph's Seminary; title page undated, catalogued 1888)
leo-latin-poems-1887: The Latin Poems of Leo XIII, done into English verse by the Jesuits of Woodstock College (Toronto: People's Publishing, 1887)
leo-poems-charades-1902: Poems, Charades, Inscriptions of Pope Leo XIII, with English translation and notes by H. T. Henry (New York and Philadelphia: Dolphin Press, 1902)

_alternates.leo-copies: Second and third editions of the Great Encyclical Letters (the third catalogued 1892 from a portrait-plate copyright); the 1903 enlarged Pope and the People; a Boston Condition of Labor

_excluded.leo-about: Henry George's open letter, Doyle's life and other books about or answering him
